Minimal Alpine-derived PocketRun runtime — actual scope as statically checked on 2026-11-19
Runtime version: alpine-3.22.8-minimal-proot-5.1.107.102-candidate2-prebound
The checked project runtime.json has variant minimal-busybox-musl, FOUR executable artifacts and TWO guest bindings. This is not the earlier full 19-ELF candidate, not the original minirootfs, and not a distribution of 16 installed Alpine packages. No apk add capability is promised.

Executable scope
1. libproot.so — modified termux PRoot v5.1.107.102 statically combined with talloc 2.5.0; 336264 bytes; SHA256 fab33311684895a2818abe2ce616bda06d352babc3602b702901f4b4893cda19. Combined executable GPLv3, original PRoot GPLv2-or-later and talloc LGPLv3-or-later notices retained.
2. libproot_loader.so — PRoot arm64 loader; 3000 bytes; SHA256 1396d5c21670602730b02c25b0d723c606a6d6f4d23c7e77cac4b6bdd70cd555; original PRoot GPLv2-or-later.
3. /bin/busybox bound to libalpine_bin_busybox.so — original Alpine busybox 1.37.0-r20/aarch64; 919304 bytes; SHA256 da988cc7d4ab9d83f1798f6e92cf4aa0ba5b0b8fd2bae5f1c7bd3f882a569c81; GPLv2-only. Dynamic dependency is only libc.musl-aarch64.so.1. Its static utmps 0.1.3.1-r0 and skalibs 2.14.4.0-r0 (libskarnet) are NOT separate ELF files but are still in the source/notice scope.
4. /lib/ld-musl-aarch64.so.1 bound to libalpine_lib_ld_musl_aarch64_so_1.so — original Alpine musl 1.2.5-r13/aarch64; 723480 bytes; SHA256 42fb025bc758b76e60e7b3b0fcdcfab93b6ba1694b363244c2e8e6f51847e28c; MIT with third-party permissive copyrights, all retained in musl-COPYRIGHT.txt and musl-source-copyright-notices.txt. No DT_NEEDED dependency.

Actual data-only asset
587 bytes; SHA256 8c4ac18ae5babcbd3f692e1c4bed6710eb965967da792fc6ad597def4a1eff06, 34 entries.
Ten directories: bin, lib, etc, root, tmp, workspace, proc, dev, usr, usr/bin.
Six regular files: original seven-byte etc/alpine-release (3.22.8 newline), PocketRun-generated passwd/group, two empty guest-code bind placeholders, and an empty 0600 dev/null placeholder for the fixed host /dev/null binding. No regular ELF or character-device node is hidden in this tar. Startup and reuse must preserve its inventory; old failed rootfs permissions are not changed.
BusyBox relative links: sh, ash, cat, wc, printf, sleep, id, pwd, ls, head, yes, tty, stty, kill, true, false, uname -> busybox, all under bin. Relative libc.musl-aarch64.so.1 -> ld-musl-aarch64.so.1 under lib.
Original /lib/apk/db, scripts.tar, 16-package installed database, /etc/apk, /usr/share/apk, CA certificates/SSL configuration, apk/libapk, ssl_client, getconf/getent/iconv, scanelf, OpenSSL engines/modules/libraries and zlib are absent from this runtime. Original inventory files in notice/ are retained only as provenance of the source minirootfs and audit of the discarded full candidate, NOT as this minimal runtime's installed-package claim.

Static dependency provenance
Official Alpine aarch64 build log:
https://build.alpinelinux.org/buildlogs/build-3-22-aarch64/main/busybox/busybox-1.37.0-r20.log
It reports abuild 3.15.0-r1, installs utmps 0.1.3.1-r0 and skalibs 2.14.4.0-r0, and records the dynamic BusyBox link command with -Wl,--push-state,-Bstatic -lutmps -lskarnet -Wl,--pop-state. The exact-version official busybox APK was privately inspected; its BusyBox bytes match the fixed original rootfs SHA, and its .PKGINFO builddate 1763764856 / commit 2e97d754a30d558f15524b8e422303c8a96832df match the fixed installed database. The build log does not itself contain that commit/epoch field; the package metadata supplies that bridge. No APK signature verification or new byte-reproducible BusyBox build is claimed.
utmps and skalibs source tarballs from skarnet.org are each verified against SHA512 in the fixed aports snapshot. Their complete ISC copyright/permission/disclaimer copies are in licenses/; their source archives and recipe evidence are in matching_sources/static-dependency-evidence/.

Minimum source-and-notice PUBLIC delivery set, before publishing this runtime
- This version-specific runtime manifest, all actual payload hashes, this scope notice, source provenance and checksums.
- PRoot+talloc 1.2 MiB immutable corresponding-source archive; six-file complete diff; dated modification notice; build/reproduce scripts and replace.h; PRoot COPYRIGHT/COPYING, GPLv2/GPLv3 and LGPLv3 text plus relevant source copyright notices.
- BusyBox 1.37.0 original source tarball, every checked fixed 1.37.0-r20 patch, busyboxconfig, APKBUILD, needed build/install control scripts; utmps 0.1.3.1 and skalibs 2.14.4.0 source plus build recipes and ISC notices; official link-time build trace. Do not omit statically embedded ISC modules because no .so file appears. The abuild 3.15.0-r1 default compilation/installation helper source, fixed APKBUILD, two checked patches and control scripts are also retained in matching_sources/build_tools/abuild/; archive SHA256 ad34ce984d2f8defb45b57c555b595db1cfbee023eda4050f2b7ec965dc8765b. Earlier endpoint failures are preserved; later exact-version collection and fixed SHA512 checks succeeded.
- musl 1.2.5 source, all fixed 1.2.5-r13 patches, APKBUILD and compile/install control sources, COPYRIGHT and third-party notices.
- Source that generates the minimal data asset and controls packaging, guest bindings and installation. An empty-placeholder tar by itself does not explain how the two code bindings are installed.
- Full GPL/MIT/ISC copyrights, license texts and modification notices must accompany the distributed works, e.g. bundled in the APK plus accessible alongside the download; merely leaving them in an unshipped source directory is insufficient.
- Offer the complete corresponding-source set with equivalent version-matched access from the binary's designated Internet distribution location (GPLv2 section 3 and GPLv3 section 6(d)). Verify public downloads and checksums, not just an intended URL. A source-only GitHub release can contain these materials, but no binary or derived rootfs may be published first with only an upstream homepage notice.

No local source compile, APK install, device acceptance, or completed public delivery is asserted by this notice. Removing unused linked executables resolves the identified OpenSSL incompatibility for THIS inspected scope, not all GPL obligations. The public-distribution gate remains pending source/notice delivery and actual packaged-APK scope checks.
